where_queries.statement: Retrieve the full profile of all registered customers who reside in the city of 'Lahore'.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Customer_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Email, Membership_Type, City FROM Customer WHERE City = 'Lahore';

where_queries.statement: Find all movies in the cinema catalog whose parental age rating is not 'R' (Restricted).
where_queries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Genre, Age_Rating, IMDb_Rating FROM Movie WHERE Age_Rating <> 'R';

where_queries.statement: Retrieve all staff members who are not assigned to the 'Morning' shift schedule.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Employee_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Designation, Department, Shift_Timing FROM Employee WHERE Shift_Timing != 'Morning';

where_queries.statement: Identify all tuck shop items that are priced affordably at less than 250 PKR.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Item_ID, Item_Name, Category, Unit_Price, Stock_Quantity FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Unit_Price < 250.00;

where_queries.statement: List all blockbuster movies with an exceptional IMDb rating strictly greater than 8.5.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Director, IMDb_Rating, Box_Office_Revenue FROM Movie WHERE IMDb_Rating > 8.5;

where_queries.statement: Find all movie showtimes that have 95 or fewer available seats remaining (selling fast).
where_queries.sql: SELECT Show_ID, Movie_ID, Screen_ID, Show_Date, Base_Price, Available_Seats, Show_Format FROM Showtime WHERE Available_Seats <= 95;

where_queries.statement: Retrieve all senior personnel earning a monthly salary of at least 75,000 PKR.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Employee_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Designation, Department, Monthly_Salary FROM Employee WHERE Monthly_Salary >= 75000.00;

where_queries.statement: Find active VIP tier members who have earned more than 400 loyalty points.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Customer_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Membership_Type, Loyalty_Points, Is_Active FROM Customer WHERE Membership_Type = 'VIP' AND Loyalty_Points > 400;

where_queries.statement: Retrieve bookings that were either confirmed or completed through the physical 'Box_Office' channel.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Booking_ID, Customer_ID, Total_Seats_Booked, Net_Payable, Booking_Status, Booking_Channel FROM Booking WHERE Booking_Status = 'Confirmed' OR Booking_Channel = 'Box_Office';

where_queries.statement: Retrieve all movies that do not belong to the 'Drama' genre.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Genre, Duration_Minutes, IMDb_Rating FROM Movie WHERE NOT (Genre = 'Drama');

where_queries.statement: Calculate ticket gross cost with an added 100 PKR surcharge for tickets with base price exceeding 1400 PKR.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Ticket_ID, Ticket_Number, Base_Price, (Base_Price + 100.00) AS Gross_Price_With_Surcharge FROM Ticket WHERE Base_Price > 1400.00;

where_queries.statement: Display bookings where customer discount was applied, showing net difference before tax.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Booking_ID, Total_Amount, Discount_Amount, (Total_Amount - Discount_Amount) AS Adjusted_Subtotal FROM Booking WHERE Discount_Amount > 0;

where_queries.statement: Compute total inventory valuation (Stock_Quantity * Cost_Price) for tuck shop items having stock over 150 units.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Item_ID, Item_Name, Stock_Quantity, Cost_Price, (Stock_Quantity * Cost_Price) AS Total_Stock_Valuation FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Stock_Quantity > 150;

where_queries.statement: Calculate the estimated hourly wage (Monthly_Salary / 160 hours) for technical and management staff earning over 70,000 PKR.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Employee_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Designation, Monthly_Salary, ROUND(Monthly_Salary / 160.0, 2) AS Hourly_Rate_PKR FROM Employee WHERE Monthly_Salary > 70000.00;

where_queries.statement: Retrieve a distinct list of all cinematic genres currently represented in the cinema database.
where_queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Genre FROM Movie WHERE Status IN ('Now Showing', 'Archived');

where_queries.statement: Aggregate customer distribution by city to determine regional customer density.
where_queries.sql: SELECT City, COUNT(Customer_ID) AS Total_Customers FROM Customer WHERE Is_Active = 1 GROUP BY City;

where_queries.statement: Identify departments whose average employee monthly salary exceeds 60,000 PKR.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Department, COUNT(Employee_ID) AS Total_Staff, ROUND(AVG(Monthly_Salary), 2) AS Avg_Monthly_Salary FROM Employee WHERE Employment_Status = 'Active' GROUP BY Department HAVING AVG(Monthly_Salary) > 60000.00;

where_queries.statement: Find all classic films released between January 1, 1990 and December 31, 2005.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Release_Date, Genre, Director FROM Movie WHERE Release_Date BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

where_queries.statement: Retrieve all customer records whose registered email address is hosted on '@gmail.com'.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Customer_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Email, City FROM Customer WHERE Email LIKE '%@gmail.com';

where_queries.statement: List all tuck shop snack items belonging specifically to the categories 'Popcorn', 'Bakery', or 'Combos'.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Item_ID, Item_Name, Category, Unit_Price, Size_Option FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Category IN ('Popcorn', 'Bakery', 'Combos');

where_queries.statement: List all movies in the cinema database sorted from highest to lowest IMDb rating.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Genre, IMDb_Rating, Duration_Minutes FROM Movie WHERE Status = 'Archived' ORDER BY IMDb_Rating DESC;

where_queries.statement: Find high-tier showtimes with base price between 1000 and 2000 PKR hosted in 'IMAX 3D' format.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Show_ID, Movie_ID, Screen_ID, Base_Price, Show_Format, Available_Seats FROM Showtime WHERE Base_Price > 1000.00 AND Base_Price < 2000.00 AND Show_Format = 'IMAX 3D';

where_queries.statement: Find all employees whose last name begins with the letter 'A' or 'M'.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Employee_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Designation, Department FROM Employee WHERE Last_Name LIKE 'A%' OR Last_Name LIKE 'M%';

where_queries.statement: Find all vehicles parked that are neither motorcycles nor passenger vans.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Parking_ID, Customer_ID, Slot_Number, Vehicle_Type, License_Plate, Total_Parking_Fee FROM Parking WHERE Vehicle_Type NOT IN ('Motorcycle', 'Van');

where_queries.statement: Retrieve all distinct customer membership tiers ordered alphabetically.
where_queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Membership_Type FROM Customer WHERE Is_Active = 1 ORDER BY Membership_Type ASC;

where_queries.operator: GROUP BY with COUNT and SUM
where_queries.statement: Display total booking count and cumulative net revenue collected per booking channel.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Booking_Channel, COUNT(Booking_ID) AS Total_Bookings, SUM(Net_Payable) AS Total_Revenue_PKR FROM Booking WHERE Booking_Status = 'Confirmed' GROUP BY Booking_Channel;

where_queries.statement: Identify cinema screens that have at least 1 showtime scheduled and capacity over 150.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Screen_ID, Total_Capacity, Sound_System FROM Screen WHERE Total_Capacity > 150 AND Is_Active = 1;

where_queries.statement: Retrieve vehicle parking sessions where parked duration was between 2.0 and 4.0 hours in parking Zone 'A'.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Parking_ID, Slot_Number, Vehicle_Type, Parked_Duration_Hours, Total_Parking_Fee FROM Parking WHERE (Parked_Duration_Hours BETWEEN 2.0 AND 4.0) AND Parking_Bay_Zone = 'A';

where_queries.statement: Identify tuck shop items offering a gross profit margin of over 200 PKR per unit (Unit_Price > Cost_Price + 200).
where_queries.sql: SELECT Item_ID, Item_Name, Unit_Price, Cost_Price, (Unit_Price - Cost_Price) AS Profit_Margin FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Unit_Price > (Cost_Price + 200.00);

where_queries.statement: List all active screens that are not 'IMAX' format, sorted by seating capacity in descending order.
where_queries.sql: SELECT Screen_ID, Screen_Name, Screen_Type, Total_Capacity, Row_Count FROM Screen WHERE Screen_Type != 'IMAX' AND Is_Active = 1 ORDER BY Total_Capacity DESC;

join_queries.statement: INNER JOIN Query 1: Retrieve customer personal details alongside their confirmed booking IDs, seats booked, and total payable.
join_queries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, c.Email, b.Booking_ID, b.Total_Seats_Booked, b.Net_Payable, b.Booking_Channel FROM Customer c INNER JOIN Booking b ON c.Customer_ID = b.Customer_ID WHERE b.Booking_Status = 'Confirmed';

join_queries.statement: INNER JOIN Query 2: Retrieve detailed showtime schedule displaying movie title, genre, screen name, show date, and format.
join_queries.sql: SELECT s.Show_ID, m.Title AS Movie_Title, m.Genre, sc.Screen_Name, sc.Screen_Type, s.Show_Date, s.Start_Time, s.Base_Price, s.Show_Format FROM Showtime s INNER JOIN Movie m ON s.Movie_ID = m.Movie_ID INNER JOIN Screen sc ON s.Screen_ID = sc.Screen_ID WHERE s.Show_Status IN ('Scheduled', 'Completed');

join_queries.statement: LEFT JOIN Query 1: List all customers and any movie reviews they have authored, including customers who haven't reviewed yet.
join_queries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, c.Membership_Type, r.Review_ID, r.Rating_Stars, r.Review_Title FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Movie_Review r ON c.Customer_ID = r.Customer_ID;
rows: Visual effects are out of this world

join_queries.statement: LEFT JOIN Query 2: Display all cinema screens and their scheduled showtimes, including screens currently without a scheduled movie.
join_queries.sql: SELECT sc.Screen_ID, sc.Screen_Name, sc.Screen_Type, sc.Total_Capacity, sh.Show_ID, sh.Show_Date, sh.Base_Price FROM Screen sc LEFT JOIN Showtime sh ON sc.Screen_ID = sh.Screen_ID WHERE sc.Screen_ID <= 40;

join_queries.statement: RIGHT JOIN Query 1: Ensure all booking records are returned along with customer contact data.
join_queries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, b.Booking_ID, b.Booking_Timestamp, b.Net_Payable, b.Payment_Status FROM Customer c RIGHT JOIN Booking b ON c.Customer_ID = b.Customer_ID;

join_queries.statement: RIGHT JOIN Query 2: Display all concession orders processed alongside employee staff details responsible for the counter.
join_queries.sql: SELECT e.Employee_ID, e.First_Name, e.Last_Name, e.Designation, co.Order_ID, co.Total_Items_Count, co.Total_Payable, co.Payment_Method FROM Employee e RIGHT JOIN Concession_Order co ON e.Employee_ID = co.Employee_ID;

join_queries.statement: FULL OUTER JOIN Query 1: Retrieve complete record set of customers and vehicle parking logs to identify both parking-only visitors and transit patrons.
join_queries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, p.Parking_ID, p.Slot_Number, p.Vehicle_Type, p.Total_Parking_Fee FROM Customer c FULL OUTER JOIN Parking p ON c.Customer_ID = p.Customer_ID;

join_queries.statement: FULL OUTER JOIN Query 2: Cross-check security guards and inspection checkpoint logs to audit staff assignment coverage.
join_queries.sql: SELECT e.Employee_ID, e.First_Name, e.Last_Name, e.Department, sc.Checkpoint_ID, sc.Gate_Name, sc.Pass_Status FROM Employee e FULL OUTER JOIN Security_Checkpoint sc ON e.Employee_ID = sc.Guard_Employee_ID;

join_queries.statement: CROSS JOIN Query 1: Generate a hypothetical matrix pairing the top 3 feature films against 3 distinct screen technology types.
join_queries.sql: SELECT m.Title AS Movie_Title, sc.Screen_Type, sc.Sound_System FROM (SELECT Movie_ID, Title FROM Movie WHERE Movie_ID <= 3) m CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Screen_Type, Sound_System FROM Screen WHERE Screen_Type IN ('IMAX', 'Gold_Class', 'Silver_Economy')) sc;

join_queries.statement: CROSS JOIN Query 2: Create a combination matrix of distinct customer membership tiers and concession snack sizes for promotional bundle planning.
join_queries.sql: SELECT m.Membership_Type, s.Size_Option FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Membership_Type FROM Customer WHERE Membership_Type IN ('Regular', 'Gold', 'VIP')) m CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Size_Option FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Size_Option IN ('Small', 'Regular', 'Large')) s;

join_queries.statement: SELF JOIN Query 1: Find pairs of employees working within the exact same department and sharing the same shift timing.
join_queries.sql: SELECT A.Employee_ID AS Emp1_ID, (A.First_Name || ' ' || A.Last_Name) AS Emp1_Name, B.Employee_ID AS Emp2_ID, (B.First_Name || ' ' || B.Last_Name) AS Emp2_Name, A.Department, A.Shift_Timing FROM Employee A INNER JOIN Employee B ON A.Department = B.Department AND A.Shift_Timing = B.Shift_Timing AND A.Employee_ID < B.Employee_ID;

join_queries.statement: SELF JOIN Query 2: Find pairs of movies that share the exact same genre but have different runtimes.
join_queries.sql: SELECT A.Movie_ID AS Movie1_ID, A.Title AS Movie1_Title, B.Movie_ID AS Movie2_ID, B.Title AS Movie2_Title, A.Genre, A.Duration_Minutes AS Duration1, B.Duration_Minutes AS Duration2 FROM Movie A INNER JOIN Movie B ON A.Genre = B.Genre AND A.Movie_ID < B.Movie_ID AND A.Duration_Minutes <> B.Duration_Minutes WHERE A.Genre = 'Action';

subqueries.statement: Find the movie that achieved the single highest worldwide box office revenue.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Director, Box_Office_Revenue FROM Movie WHERE Box_Office_Revenue = (SELECT MAX(Box_Office_Revenue) FROM Movie);

subqueries.statement: Find all cinema employees whose monthly salary is greater than the overall cinema average monthly salary.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Employee_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Designation, Department, Monthly_Salary FROM Employee WHERE Monthly_Salary > (SELECT AVG(Monthly_Salary) FROM Employee);

subqueries.statement: Identify the top loyalty customer who holds the absolute maximum number of loyalty points.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Customer_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Email, Membership_Type, Loyalty_Points FROM Customer WHERE Loyalty_Points = (SELECT MAX(Loyalty_Points) FROM Customer);

subqueries.statement: Retrieve details of all customers who have booked tickets for any movie directed by 'Christopher Nolan'.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Customer_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Email, Membership_Type FROM Customer WHERE Customer_ID IN (SELECT b.Customer_ID FROM Booking b INNER JOIN Showtime s ON b.Show_ID = s.Show_ID WHERE s.Movie_ID IN (SELECT Movie_ID FROM Movie WHERE Director = 'Christopher Nolan'));

subqueries.statement: Retrieve all tuck shop concession items that have never been ordered in any concession transaction.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Item_ID, Item_Name, Category, Unit_Price, Stock_Quantity FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Item_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT Item_ID FROM Concession_Item_Order);

subqueries.statement: Find all screens currently hosting scheduled showtimes priced above 1500 PKR.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Screen_ID, Screen_Name, Screen_Type, Total_Capacity, Sound_System FROM Screen WHERE Screen_ID IN (SELECT Screen_ID FROM Showtime WHERE Base_Price > 1500.00);

subqueries.statement: Retrieve movies whose duration exceeds the average duration of all movies in the 'Sci-Fi' genre.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Genre, Duration_Minutes, Director FROM Movie WHERE Duration_Minutes > (SELECT AVG(Duration_Minutes) FROM Movie WHERE Genre = 'Sci-Fi');

subqueries.statement: Retrieve customer information for the patron who paid the highest single booking amount in the system.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Customer_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Email, City FROM Customer WHERE Customer_ID = (SELECT Customer_ID FROM Booking WHERE Net_Payable = (SELECT MAX(Net_Payable) FROM Booking));

subqueries.statement: Find tuck shop items that are priced strictly higher than the average price of items in the 'Beverages' category.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Item_ID, Item_Name, Category, Unit_Price FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Unit_Price > (SELECT AVG(Unit_Price) FROM Tuck_Shop WHERE Category = 'Beverages');

subqueries.statement: Find all movies whose IMDb rating is strictly above the average IMDb rating of movies within the exact same genre.
subqueries.sql: SELECT m1.Movie_ID, m1.Title, m1.Genre, m1.IMDb_Rating FROM Movie m1 WHERE m1.IMDb_Rating > (SELECT AVG(m2.IMDb_Rating) FROM Movie m2 WHERE m2.Genre = m1.Genre);

subqueries.statement: Find all employees whose monthly salary exceeds the average monthly salary of their own respective department.
subqueries.sql: SELECT e1.Employee_ID, e1.First_Name, e1.Last_Name, e1.Department, e1.Monthly_Salary FROM Employee e1 WHERE e1.Monthly_Salary > (SELECT AVG(e2.Monthly_Salary) FROM Employee e2 WHERE e2.Department = e1.Department);

subqueries.statement: Identify customers whose individual spending on bookings exceeds the average total booking expenditure of all customers.
subqueries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, c.Membership_Type FROM Customer c WHERE (SELECT SUM(b.Net_Payable) FROM Booking b WHERE b.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID) > (SELECT AVG(Net_Payable) FROM Booking);

subqueries.statement: Retrieve all customers who have at least one successfully cleared security screening recorded at a checkpoint.
subqueries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, c.Email FROM Customer c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Security_Checkpoint sc WHERE sc.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID AND sc.Pass_Status = 'Approved');

subqueries.statement: Find screens that have at least one wheelchair accessible seat installed.
subqueries.sql: SELECT sc.Screen_ID, sc.Screen_Name, sc.Screen_Type, sc.Total_Capacity FROM Screen sc WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Seat st WHERE st.Screen_ID = sc.Screen_ID AND st.Is_Wheelchair_Accessible = 1);

subqueries.statement: Identify registered customers who have never utilized the cinema vehicle parking facility.
subqueries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, c.City FROM Customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Parking p WHERE p.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID);

subqueries.statement: Retrieve movies currently in catalog that have received zero critical ratings below 4 stars.
subqueries.sql: SELECT m.Movie_ID, m.Title, m.Genre, m.IMDb_Rating FROM Movie m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Movie_Review r WHERE r.Movie_ID = m.Movie_ID AND r.Rating_Stars < 4);

subqueries.statement: Find employees whose salary is greater than the salary of AT LEAST ONE (ANY) employee in the 'Ticketing' department.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Employee_ID, First_Name, Last_Name, Designation, Department, Monthly_Salary FROM Employee WHERE Monthly_Salary > ANY (SELECT Monthly_Salary FROM Employee WHERE Department = 'Ticketing');

subqueries.statement: Find movies that earned more in worldwide box office revenue than ALL movies in the 'Animation' category.
subqueries.sql: SELECT Movie_ID, Title, Genre, Box_Office_Revenue FROM Movie WHERE Box_Office_Revenue > ALL (SELECT Box_Office_Revenue FROM Movie WHERE Genre = 'Animation');

subqueries.statement: Display each customer's basic profile alongside a computed count of total tickets they have booked.
subqueries.sql: SELECT c.Customer_ID, c.First_Name, c.Last_Name, c.Membership_Type, (SELECT COUNT(t.Ticket_ID) FROM Ticket t INNER JOIN Booking b ON t.Booking_ID = b.Booking_ID WHERE b.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID) AS Total_Tickets_Purchased FROM Customer c WHERE c.Customer_ID <= 15;

subqueries.statement: From a derived table aggregating sales statistics per booking channel, display channels where average transaction value exceeds 1800 PKR.
subqueries.sql: SELECT dt.Booking_Channel, dt.Total_Bookings, dt.Total_Revenue, dt.Avg_Booking_Value FROM (SELECT Booking_Channel, COUNT(Booking_ID) AS Total_Bookings, SUM(Net_Payable) AS Total_Revenue, ROUND(AVG(Net_Payable), 2) AS Avg_Booking_Value FROM Booking GROUP BY Booking_Channel) AS dt WHERE dt.Avg_Booking_Value > 1800.00;
